title: Woman is healed and shown she will be a healer
content:
I slipped out of my body, Jesus and angels healed me. The spirits downloaded information to me and showed me my future and what I would be doing. They told me I would be giving Spiritual talks and giving HOPE & HEALING to people all over the world. They chanted these words as they healed my body: "THIS IS THE DAY THAT THE LORD HAS MADE, LET US REJOICE AND BE GLAD IN IT."

They showed me my friends and people in my life and the reasons I was in their life.

They downloaded information for me to tell people.

For 14 days afterwards, I was one with everything and had very clear visions.

I now heal people as an Ayurvedic practitioner, healer, and spiritual counselor.
